cues.en: So we all know that artificial intelligence and deep learning with artificial neural networks are all the rage now, so it's not surprising that there is a lot of research around applying
cues.zh: 大家都知道，人工智慧，以及人工神經網路的深度學習，現在非常熱門，因此有很多研究，探討如何將
深度學習應用到推薦系統，並不意外。

cues.en: Matrix factorization can be implemented with a neural network, so we've already achieved a lot of the same results you can get through deep learning.
cues.zh: 矩陣分解也能用神經網路實作，因此我們其實已經達到許多深度學習能做到的相同結果。

cues.en: It's just another way to implement the same thing.
cues.zh: 只是用另一種方式實作同一件事。

cues.en: SVD seems spooky in how good it is, in the same way that deep learning often seems spooky.
cues.zh: SVD 好得讓人覺得不可思議，就像深度學習常讓人有同樣感覺。

cues.en: And there's a very good reason for that.
Both techniques can have the same results.
cues.zh: 兩種技術，可能產生相同結果。

cues.en: But deep learning also opens up entirely new approaches to making recommendations that are worth exploring.
cues.zh: 但深度學習也開啟了完全不同、值得探索的推薦方法。

cues.en: A lot of this is still bleeding-edge stuff, but it's where things are headed for the time being, so it's important to understand.
cues.zh: 很多仍是前沿技術，但目前發展正朝這個方向前進，因此有必要了解。

cues.en: But before we can understand how to apply deep learning and artificial neural networks to recommender systems, first we need to understand how deep learning and artificial neural networks work.
cues.zh: 不過，在了解如何將深度學習與人工神經網路應用到推薦系統之前，先要了解它們如何運作。

cues.en: If you're already familiar with deep learning and Tensorflow in particular, you can probably get away with skipping this next section.
cues.zh: 如果已經熟悉深度學習，尤其 TensorFlow，接下來這一節大概可以跳過。

cues.en: But if Tensorflow and neural networks are new to you, or you're just rusty, I encourage you to go through the next section so you understand how it works before we try to apply these tools to recommender systems.
cues.zh: 但如果 TensorFlow 與神經網路對你很陌生，或只是生疏了，鼓勵你看完下一節，先了解運作方式，再將工具用於推薦系統。

cues.en: This section is adapted from a portion of a larger, free course that I offer on YouTube on deep learning and neural networks, so if you want to dive deeper, just search for Sundog Education on YouTube
cues.zh: 這一節改編自我在 YouTube 提供、規模更大的免費深度學習與神經網路課程的一部分。如果想深入，只要在 YouTube 搜尋 Sundog Education，

cues.en: We're not going to talk about recommender systems in this section.
cues.zh: 這一節不會談推薦系統。

cues.en: We're going to cover the concepts of deep neural networks in more general terms.
cues.zh: 我們會以較一般的方式，介紹深度神經網路概念。

cues.en: Then, in subsequent sections, we'll apply what we've learned to the problem of recommender systems.
cues.zh: 接著，後續章節再把所學，應用到推薦系統問題。
